title: Bayesian Ordered Lattice Design (BOLD) Phase I Trial Simulator
description: An independent research Shiny application comparing BOLD and BOIN operating characteristics. Version 1.1.0 adds configurable dose count, starting dose, dose-specific BOLD prior means, PESS, toxicity cutoffs and stopping limits, with regression tests. General-use instructions are followed by a four-dose CD229 CAR-T simulation example, selected upper-dose figure and full six-scenario results. BOLD advantages are scenario-dependent and accompanied by safety trade-offs; these are simulations, not clinical outcomes. Experimental BOLD is documented separately and is not an app option. For research and design review, not live clinical dose assignment. Method: https://doi.org/10.1002/sim.70456. App: https://wguo3.shinyapps.io/bold_boin_phase1_app/.
